races.verdict: WITHOUT DELAY has been shaping up well here in recent weeks and now dropped back to a sprint trip for the first time since her juvenile days, Tracy Waggott's mare could be the answer. She gets the nod over Mister Sky Blue , who gives his running more often than most at this level but finds winning difficult. Golden Prosperity can edge out Society Charm for third. WITHOUT DELAY (IRE) MISTER SKY BLUE (IRE) GOLDEN PROSPERITY (IRE)

races.verdict: NAUTIC STAR has been out of the frame just once in her 8 career starts and this looks a good opportunity for Jessica Harrington's filly to get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Donna Time , who found listed company all too much on just her fourth career start in the summer but can get back on track returning in much calmer waters. Elusive Path and Senna's Girl round off the shortlist. NAUTIC STAR (IRE) DONNA TIME (IRE) ELUSIVE PATH (IRE)

THE BLUE PANTHER (IRE) PLATINO BIANCO (IRE) CHAVAJOD

races.verdict: OSTERODE advanced her form when runner-up at Down Royal at the start of the month and looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to go one better for her in-form handler. races.verdict: VENETIAN LION has proved most progressive since a tongue strap was fitted, completing his hat-trick at Pontefract 13 days ago with more in hand than the bare margin so he's going to be tough to stop up 5 lb. Sea Founder makes loads of appeal back up to 1m but isn't the best drawn and may have to settle for a place, while Silent City looks interesting on all-weather debut. races.verdict: STRAIGHT HOME showed she retains her ability at the second time of asking back from an absence when runner-up at Ballinrobe recently and can build on that and go one better now, possibly at the expense of stablemate Soir De Garde , who is the mount of Paul Townend. Chanceawetmorning should also have a say if suffering no ill effects from his late fall at Kilbeggan. STRAIGHT HOME (IRE) SOIR DE GARDE (FR) CHANCEAWETMORNING (IRE)

races.verdict: WESTERN MODEL shaped well when second over fences at Downpatrick recently and is taken to build on that promise and prove too strong for course specialist Cornmarket and last month's Tramore runner-up Pourquoi Poi . The fact Ballagh Star has won the last 2 runnings of this race means it would be no surprise were he to leave a string of poor efforts behind. WESTERN MODEL (IRE) CORNMARKET (IRE) POURQUOI POI (IRE)
